args.sql:
ALTER TABLE employment_and_income ADD COLUMN fsi numeric;

DO $$
DECLARE
    emp_rec RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR emp_rec IN SELECT ei.emplcoreref, ei.debincratio, ei.mthincome, ea.liqassets, ea.bankaccbal, ea.savamount
                   FROM employment_and_income ei
                   JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON ei.emplcoreref = ea.expemplref
    LOOP
        UPDATE employment_and_income
        SET fsi = 0.3 * (1 - ei.debincratio) 
              + 0.3 * (ea.liqassets / (ei.mthincome * 6))
              + 0.2 * (ea.bankaccbal / (ei.mthincome * 3))
              + 0.2 * (ea.savamount / (ei.mthincome * 12))
        FROM expenses_and_assets ea
        WHERE employment_and_income.emplcoreref = ei.emplcoreref
          AND employment_and_income.emplcoreref = ea.expemplref;
    END LOOP;
END $$;

BEGIN
    FOR emp_rec IN SELECT ei.emplcoreref, ei.debincratio, ei.mthincome, ea.liqassets, ea.bankaccbal, ea.savamount
                   FROM employment_and_income ei
                   JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON ei.emplcoreref = ea.expemplref
    LOOP
        UPDATE employment_and_income
        SET fsi = 0.3 * (1 - emp_rec.debincratio) 
              + 0.3 * (emp_rec.liqassets / (emp_rec.mthincome * 6))
              + 0.2 * (emp_rec.bankaccbal / (emp_rec.mthincome * 3))
              + 0.2 * (emp_rec.savamount / (emp_rec.mthincome * 12))
        WHERE emplcoreref = emp_rec.emplcoreref;
